items.q: his piano player was Hank Jones... I attended a rehearsal sometime, and I joined the band. We went on the road.

ctx.x: I mean, how did you come to join Lips in the first place?

Well, his piano player was Hank Jones, and Hank was leaving. So that's how we... I attended a rehearsal sometime, and I joined the band. We went on the road. I remember the first day we played, in South Chicago at the Grand Terrace. The Grand Terrace closed in on us, and we had no money, and then we were stranded in Chicago.
